name: v4.0.527
body:
## What's Changed

- `@remotion/studio`: Add multi-clip splitting by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11463
- `@remotion/studio`: Add Generate captions quick action for media by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11442
- `remotion`: Treat undefined spring config properties as defaults by @costajohnt in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11438
- `@remotion/lambda`: Fix duplicated horizontal strips in renders by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11446
- `@remotion/player`: Change `numberOfSharedAudioTags` default to 0 in v5 by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11445
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix BT.709 color conversion for JPEG frames by @anthod0 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11331
- `@remotion/studio`: Set `interpolate()` output types for generated keyframes by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11418
- `@remotion/studio`: Show Props editor in read-only Studio by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11492
- `@remotion/studio`: Keep inline actions visible while menus are open by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11457
- `@remotion/studio`: Stop auto-selecting compositions in hosted Studio by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11456
- `@remotion/studio`: Hide transcription actions for videos without audio by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11482
- `@remotion/studio`: Treat percentage translate as computed by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11483
- `@remotion/studio`: Change modal dismiss icon by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11449
- `@remotion/studio`: Add WebKit-prefixed user-select styles by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11424
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix copy to clipboard in Safari by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11443
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix stale composition actions in Assets quick switcher by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11454
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix timeline flicker while zooming by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11494
- `@remotion/studio`: Preview and snap Element canvas drops by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11488
- [`@remotion/studio-protocol`: Add `buildOpenInRemotionNewUrl()` to open Elements](https://remotion.dev/docs/studio-protocol/build-open-in-remotion-new-url) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11420
- `@remotion/whisper-webgpu`: Roll Transformers.js back to 4.2.0 by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11466

## Docs

- Document ESLint config and plugin packages by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11453
- Add brand asset download to logo context menu by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11447
- Move color correction page to Adding video by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11426
- Suppress MapLibre worker bundler warning by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11451

## Internal and Experimental

- [`@remotion/codemods`: Add `deleteJsxNode()` for removing mounted JSX](https://remotion.dev/docs/codemods/delete-jsx-nodes) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11471
- [`@remotion/browser-bundler`: Add `createBrowserBundler()` to compile virtual projects](https://remotion.dev/docs/browser-bundler) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11416
- `@remotion/canvas-capture-extension`: Open recordings in Browser Studio by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11461
- remotion.dev: Add Explore Remotion preview page by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11495
- Skills: Simplify issue creation guidance by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11452
- Add simultaneous video playback testbed by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11486
- Consolidate GSAP renderer parity workflows by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11477
- Retry stalled package checks by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11444
- Fix Studio bundle empty state assertion by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11490
- Remove flaky shared inspector E2E test by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11459
- Remove low-value Example E2E tests by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11423
- Remove deprecated WebCodecs CI tests by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11434

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/compare/v4.0.526...v4.0.527
